answer_1.quote: In this work, we explore the extension of large-scale conversational agents to image-based dialogue.
answer_1.outputs: responses conditioned on both visual and textual context

answer_2.quote: We measure model perplexity on the COCO and pushshift.io Reddit validation sets.

answer_4.quote: We then perform ACUTE-Evals ) on the collected conversations of MMB Style and BlenderBot in order for crowdsourced raters to directly compare conversations from different models in an A/B setting.
answer_4.guideline: The Preference metric asks, "Who would you prefer to talk to for a long conversation?", and the Humanness metric asks, "Which speaker sounds more human?". The Image-response metric asks, "Who talks about the image better?"
